Motor Components.name: Silicon
Motor Components.reasoning: Silicon is used as an alloying element in electrical steel for reducing losses, very commonly used though specialized steels may vary slightly in silicon content.

Motor Components.name: Aluminum
Motor Components.reasoning: Aluminum may be used in some winding or structural components due to its light weight and conductivity but less common than copper; alternatives exist.
